These tone classes are neutralised in the verbal noun. Tupuri has no verb tone classes. The Non-Low class is High in Mbum, Mid in Karang and Kuo." | Kunzmann 2026: 113: "Both forms follow a H-L tone pattern, with the H tone spreading across all tone-bearing units except for the final one, on which the L tone realizes." | Beyer 2024: "Only the fact that it is marked by tone reveals its Mbum-nature (Fula not being a tone language). The tonal marking for clearly Fula-origin elements further hints to the fact that they are used in the tone language environment of Mbum."

new_statements.rule_in_words: Mbum (Nganha) is a two-level (H/L) tone language; none of the accessible sources says anything about word stress or accent. The primary phonology (Hagège 1968; 1970, with a prosody/tone chapter) could not be opened beyond a segmental excerpt.
new_statements.domain_note: Tone statements only (lexical tone classes on verbs, H-L melodies on words); no stress domain described. Boyd's statement is family-level (Southern Mbum group = Mbum, Mbere, Kpere) reported second-hand by Elders.
new_statements.identity_note: All modern sources (Hagège 1968/1970, Mohamadou 2006, Kunzmann 2026, Beyer 2024) describe the Mbum of Nganha (central Adamawa plateau, near Ngaoundéré), the prestige variety of mbum1254; Hino 1978 is Mbang-Mboum (same central group). Kouemou Mouga 2001 describes Gbete/Kepere (eastern variety, Bertoua-Belabo), also under mbum1254. Boyd's 'Southern Mbum group' statement covers Mbum together with Mbere and Kpere. Not to be confused with Karang (kara1481) or Nzakambay (nzak1247; Ladogana 1991 'Grammaire mbum nzaka mbay').

tone.quote: Given this descriptive gap, my research aims to provide a general overview of the phonological and tonological characteristics of Mbum, as it is spoken today in Ngaoundéré and Nganha (Adamawa region, northern Cameroon). … I discuss selected prominent phonetic and phonological features of the Adamawa language and point out peculiarities of the sound inventory and the tone system. Among these hitherto undocumented matters are e.g. grammatical tone, the assignment of tones to suffixes, [-ATR] vowels and their arrangement in harmonic patterns and the distinctiveness of vowel length.

tone.quote: various phonetic and phonological features of the language are up-to-now undocumented … Amongst these matters are e.g. the nature and behavior of tone, [-ATR] vowels and their arrangement in harmonic patterns, the distinctiveness of vowel length, and many others. My research tackles this descriptive gap – the phonology and tonology of Mbum – … In my talk, I present current data and (preliminary) findings from recent research, and discuss peculiarities of the sound inventory, syllable structures and selected features of the tone system.
